question: Which three of the following can be used as authentication methods for Microsoft Entra multifactor authentication (MFA)? (Select three.)

options.text: A notification or code from the Microsoft Authenticator app
A verification code sent by SMS text message
A picture password drawn on the sign-in screen

explanation:
Microsoft Entra MFA supports methods including the **Microsoft Authenticator app** (push notifications and time-based codes), **FIDO2 security keys** (phishing-resistant hardware or platform keys), **SMS text codes**, voice calls, and OATH hardware/software tokens.

**Why not the other options:**
- **Security questions** — In Microsoft Entra ID, security questions can be used only for self-service password reset (SSPR), never as an MFA method for sign-in, because knowledge-based answers are too easy to discover.
- **A picture password** — Picture passwords are a local Windows sign-in convenience feature; they are not an authentication method offered by Microsoft Entra MFA.
category: Describe the capabilities of Microsoft Entra
